begin_request_behavior: OPTIONAL helper only VALIDATES request-supplied env values (empty/inconsistent => syntax-error Indeterminate); never injects (StandardEnvironmentAttributeProvider.java:189+). Our requests supply zero env values => no-op.
builder_category_pin: insert_attribute filters subject Attributes by Category == triple access-subject only (build_repaired_requests.py subject_nodes filter); cannot touch the environment category by construction.
conclusion: Handler-added content is authorization-inert for the measured interface: no evaluation path in the frozen policy reads environment attributes or current-time functions, and the sole configured addition channel (std-env provider, override=false) serves current-* environment attributes only.

provider_scope.default: enabled with override=false (pdp.xsd standardAttributeProvidersEnabled default true; StdEnvAttributeProviderDescriptor override default false)
provider_scope.fires_only_when: a current-* attribute is requested during evaluation (lazy get) or per XACML 10.2.5 MUST-supply when absent-and-requested

request_env_values.method: mechanical census over request bytes (Attributes with environment Category carrying values)

resolved_equality: With frozen defaults, resolved evaluation bags equal request bags for every category in our evaluations: the only addition channel is proven inert (never fires: zero env designators, zero time functions, zero env values supplied). Handler MAY-add remains true in general XACML; it has no configured channel here.

time_path.getCreationTimestamp: enters only via env attributes (inert per above)
time_path.overrideEvalCtxFromTimestamp: fires only on env-attribute evaluation paths (inert per above)
